product_question: Does adding codegraph_* improve today's default (grep + read)? Additive treatment only.
caveat: n=12 prove keys on one TypeScript monorepo (ClawQL) is a small test on CodeGraph home turf. Predeclared margin + no-harm + no-tools + usage recording are required so a home-turf win cannot sneak past a weak bar.

no_harm.purpose: Adding CodeGraph tools must not distract the agent on easy questions (not: can CodeGraph replace grep)

arms.purpose: ClawQL is public; measure how much the frontier model answers from memory alone
Additive — today's default PLUS codegraph_*. This is the beat arm.

usage_evidence.record: Per question: whether any codegraph_* tool was called in the treatment arm
usage_evidence.interpretation: If the agent has grep+CodeGraph and never calls codegraph_*, that answers the purpose question on its own (no added value in practice).

arms.purpose: Diagnostic — can CodeGraph replace grep? Does NOT decide freeze. Optional in live spend; report if run.

definitions.W: #prove keys treatment (grep+CodeGraph) correct and grep-only wrong
definitions.L: #prove keys grep-only correct and treatment wrong

codegraph_beats.note: Net is the extra value of bundling CodeGraph on top of grep

no_harm_pass.rule: On the 6 grep-solvable no-harm keys, A-codegraph (grep+CodeGraph) answer-correct count >= 5 (allow one flake). Failure => treat as tie => purge.
no_harm_pass.interpretation: Checks that CodeGraph's extra tools do not distract the agent on easy questions — not whether CodeGraph can do grep's job.
also_report: A-no-tools prove + no-harm rates (memory baseline; does not rescue CodeGraph)
A-codegraph-only rates if diagnostic arm was run (does not change beat)

report: fraction of prove keys where used_codegraph=true
fraction of no-harm keys where used_codegraph=true
usage_evidence.note: If treatment wins Net but almost never calls codegraph_*, treat as weak evidence for bundling — publish and prefer purge/tie judgment in freeze writeup.

no_tools_reporting.note: If A-no-tools already clears many prove keys, the Net vs grep overstates tool value — publish the rates; do not keep on memory alone.

diagnostic_codegraph_only.note: Answers 'can CodeGraph replace grep?' — skews both ways vs real deployments; never use for keep/purge.

human_pass_gate.prove_keys: review all 12; confirm single grep cannot answer each
human_pass_gate.doc_keys: stratified random sample ~60; stop if >=3 defects and fix builder
